## Frequently Asked Questions

Everything you need to know about ViralWiz. Can't find an answer? Contact our support team .

### How accurate are the AI-generated subtitles?

High accuracy on clear audio using state-of-the-art Whisper. Supports 100+ languages, automatic punctuation, casing, and word-level timestamps for karaoke effects.

### What's the difference between ViralWiz and Submagic / Captions / Opus Clip?

ViralWiz combines all three in one tool: viral subtitles (like Submagic), auto-clipping long videos (like Opus Clip), and AI thumbnails (like ThumbMagic), at 1.25× their quotas with 14-53% lower prices. One subscription, no juggling tools.

### Can I cancel anytime? Are there refunds?

Yes, cancel anytime from your account settings, you keep access until the end of your billing period, no questions asked. We offer a 7-day money-back guarantee on first subscriptions if you're not satisfied.

### Do unused minutes roll over to next month?

No, quotas reset on the 1st of each month. We deliberately keep pricing simple and transparent (no rollover, no overage surprises). Business plan users can opt-in to overage billing at $0.10/min if they want unlimited usage.

### Can I publish directly to TikTok, YouTube, Instagram?

Yes. Pro and Business plans include 1-click publishing to TikTok, YouTube Shorts, Instagram Reels, X (Twitter), and LinkedIn. Schedule posts in advance, or publish to all platforms at once with platform-specific caption optimization.

### What video formats and durations do you support?

All major formats: MP4, MOV, AVI, MKV, WebM, M4V. Max file size 250MB. Video duration limits depend on your plan (2-30 min/video). You can also import directly from a YouTube/TikTok/Instagram URL.

### Can I customize the subtitle styles?

55+ professional templates or fully custom: brand colors, fonts, positioning, animations (karaoke word-by-word, color alternance, emoji sync). Save your styles as presets and reuse across projects.

### How fast is the processing?

Most videos are subtitled in 30-60 seconds. Pro and Business plans get priority queue. Export to MP4 takes another 1-3 minutes depending on length and quality.

### Can I translate my subtitles to another language?

Yes, Pro and Business plans include AI subtitle translation into 40+ languages. Context-aware translations optimized for spoken content (preserves slang, informal register, natural speech flow).

### Can I export subtitles separately (SRT, VTT)?

Yes, on any paid plan (Starter and above). Export as SRT or VTT files for use in any video editor, or burn directly into your video in 720p, 1080p, or 4K (Business).

### Is my video content private and secure?

Your videos are stored on Cloudflare R2 and processed only to provide the features you request. We never sell your content or use it to train AI models. Delete a project anytime to remove its associated data.

### Do you offer team / business accounts?

Yes, Business plan ($59/mo) includes up to 10 team members with role-based permissions (Viewer/Editor/Admin), shared projects, timeline comments, and 4K export. Need more seats? Contact us for custom pricing.

### Is there a free trial?

We offer a free plan (3 videos, up to 2 min each, with watermark) so you can test the product without a credit card. Upgrade anytime to remove the watermark and unlock more features.

### What if I exceed my monthly quota?

Free, Starter, and Pro plans are hard-blocked at the limit (you get a notification before reaching it). Business users can optionally enable overage billing at $0.10/min, fully opt-in, with explicit consent and a confirmation dialog. No surprise charges.

### Can I get a refund if I cancel?

Cancellations take effect at the end of your current billing period, you keep access until then. We offer a 7-day money-back guarantee on first subscriptions. After that, refunds are case-by-case (contact support).

### Do you have an affiliate program?

Yes! Earn 33% recurring commission on net revenue from each referred subscription for up to 12 months. Real-time tracking, monthly PayPal payouts at $50 minimum. Sign up at /affiliate.
